title: A rectangle with a drop shadow
concept: A <TransparencySetting> after the rectangle's <Properties> carries a <DropShadowSetting>; Mode="Drop" switches it on, XOffset/YOffset move it and Size sets the width of its soft edge.

annotations.note: Object-level effects live in a <TransparencySetting> child of the page item, written after its <Properties>.

Mode="Drop" turns the shadow on (Mode="None" keeps the settings but draws nothing). XOffset and YOffset are the offset in points, positive to the right and down. Size is the width of the soft band, Opacity a percentage, EffectColor the shadow colour.
